tests.name: Sum of components
tests.acceptance: sum by use = total relevant GFA with clearly defined exclusions
tests.response_on_failure: Blocks model save on mismatch above tolerance.

tests.name: Parking capacity
tests.acceptance: total physically available parking GFA >= modeled required area across all levels
tests.response_on_failure: High-impact warning if modeled constructed area short.

tests.name: Unit mix share
tests.acceptance: Unit fractions sum 100%; counts integer; unit categories correct

tests.name: Sources/uses
tests.acceptance: Total funding sources + equity = uses incl. financing interest

tests.name: Cash ledger identity
tests.acceptance: Debt close = open + draw + capitalized interest - repayments

tests.name: Borrowing constraints
tests.acceptance: Loan <= minimum applicable LTC, LTV, DSCR and program caps
tests.response_on_failure: Checks multiple constraints not just one.

tests.name: IRR and NPV
tests.acceptance: Known cash-flow fixtures, negative flows, uneven dates for XIRR

tests.name: DCF vs ROI
tests.acceptance: Levered cash flows subtract only debt service; unlevered excludes financing

tests.name: Rate refresh
tests.acceptance: Approved scenario remains pinned to observed historic rate; new rate raises diff event

tests.name: Validity windows
tests.acceptance: Rule applies only within dates/geographic boundaries; superseded rules retired
tests.response_on_failure: AHF closed program not available to new project.

tests.name: GST/HST & rebates
tests.acceptance: Eligible vs ineligible tax cash flows, self-supply and rebate dates

tests.name: Assumption propagation
tests.acceptance: A 10% rent change affects matching revenue, NOI, debt tests and IRR

tests.name: Rate change sensitivity
tests.acceptance: Raising benchmark rate increases variable debt interest, ceteris paribus

tests.name: Source provenance
tests.acceptance: Each non-user fact links to source, retrieved-on, effective date and reviewer

tests.name: Units
tests.acceptance: ft²/m² conversions, percent vs decimal and annual vs monthly rates

tests.name: Period consistency
tests.acceptance: Timing and sign for deposits, construction, pre-sales, exit and loan payoff
tests.response_on_failure: XIRR and annual IRR differ appropriately for irregular timing.
